headline: Nigeria Business Activity Eases to 55.7 in October
summary: Nigeria's Stanbic IBTC Bank PMI slipped to 55.7 in October from 56.4 previously, coming in below the 57.2 forecast as fuel costs lifted prices.
why: Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data provides professional investors with a timely monthly gauge of economic health, input cost pressures, and private sector momentum in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: PMI readings measure overall private sector business activity trends.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
